### Fulgora Mall 

**Tech Level:**
- 4 planets tech
- Normal quality items only

**Input:**
- 2 Stacked belts of scraps
- Heavy Oil

**Output:**
- All fulgora items (Except mech armor)
- Items needed on Fulgora (rails, belts, inserters, etc)
- 495 SPM

**To Start:**
- Just build the blueprint and connect all inputs, it will power itself
- If you want to make things faster, you can connect it to a power network

### Updates

##### v1.6 - 9/1/2026

* **Capacity:** Increased mall stock targets so you’re more likely to have enough when you need it
* **Fix:** Fast inserter production was using Quality Modules 2 instead of Quality Modules 3
* **Fix:** Corrected wrong request on the Level 2 roboport buffer chest
* **Fix:** Corrected wrong request on the Tesla turret buffer chest
* **Fix:** Fixed radar production
* **Fix:** Fixed battery delivery to personal roboport production
* **Throughput:** Added a 4th rocket silo
* **Logistics:** Converted several passive provider chests to buffer chests (better local availability / export control)
* **Export:** Now buffering all Fulgora intermediates in buffer chests for export
* **Balance:** Removed 2 holmium foundries (excess capacity)
* **Balance:** Removed quality modules from Quality Module 2 EMP production (not useful in this setup)
* **Balance:** Removed quality modules from bot production (not worth the complications in early–mid game)

##### v1.5.3 - 18/11/2025
- Fixed a wrong alert message

##### v1.5.2 - 16/11/2025

- Fix: Several chemical plants weren't connected correctly
- Fix: Incorrect inserters for constructor bots and logistics bots
- Fix: Replaced fast inserters to bulk inserters for assembling machine production to meet the correct rates
- Fix: Removed productivity modules from Lubricant production and replaced it with efficiency modules. No need for productivity when heavy oil is free
- Feat: Replaced some pipes with underground pipes for easier navigation in the factory
- Fix: Increased water production - the factory throwed ice while it needed it
- Feat: Added some efficiency modules to recyclers to reduce power requirements
- Feat: Increased lighting rods production by adding a stone bricks production as needed
- Feat: Added repair pack production
- Fix: 2 rocket fuel assembling machines weren't properly connected
